note: One shell. Rooms change clothes. Look is free. Functions wait on Unity ID. Checkout closed.

rooms.title: Front door
rooms.cafe: You just walked in. That's Iris. Ask her what this place is.

rooms.title: Talk to Iris
rooms.cafe: Same conversation as the front door, with the lights on. Camera stays off until you ask. She talks back.

rooms.title: Money that already left
rooms.cafe: You already paid somebody. This room is about leftover that should have come home. Looking is free. Nobody here is treating you.

rooms.title: Where the computers sit
rooms.cafe: The work runs close to you, not in a costume cloud. You can look at the catalog. Turning the knobs waits on an ID.

rooms.title: The reading pile
rooms.cafe: Notes and papers. Look all you want. Long computer jobs are a prepaid pack. She'll say the price as a sentence first.

rooms.title: One name
rooms.cafe: If you want to do more than look, you need one ID so you are not ten logins. You can walk away after. Sales stay closed.

rooms.title: Rink (look)
rooms.cafe: A rink-shaped room so you can see the idea. Hockey is a room, not the company. No plays fire without an ID.

rooms.title: Mission control
rooms.cafe: Pick a room. Same building. Different clothes.
